author: Unreal Engine
description:
Join us as Tripo walks through how their services provide AI 3D model generation for Unreal Engine and UEFN. They'll demo how to generate game-ready 3D models from text or images in seconds, with clean quad topology and adjustable polygon counts, refine your assets with built-in post-processing tools, including smart UV mapping, auto-rigging, and animation.

For more information on the Epic AI MegaJam, click here: https://www.unrealengine.com/news/2026-epic-ai-megajam
https://itch.io/jam/2026-epic-ai-megajam
title: Epic AI MegaJam | Tripo

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Join us as Apek Panigrahi from Fal.ai shows what agentic game development looks like in practice: directing a crew of AI agents across Unreal Engine, Blender and the browser to build three games, including VIPER 11 and the multiplayer shooter Glory or Death. He’ll walk through how the classic concept-to-polish pipeline turns into overlapping threads run by one creator, with live demos in Unreal Engine 5.9, a Blender scene built from reference images, and renders sent out to fal’s serverless GPU farm.

For more information on the Epic AI MegaJam, click here: https://www.unrealengine.com/news/2026-epic-ai-megajam
https://itch.io/jam/2026-epic-ai-megajam
title: Epic AI MegaJam | Fal.ai
